'''Chapter 217''' is titled "Stowaway."

==Cover Page==
[[Hatchan's Sea-Floor Stroll]], Vol. 31: "Save the Catfish Village! Treasure Into Tools".

[[Hatchan]] has resolved to help the catfish village after all—by using all of [[Macro]]'s treasure to buy tools for the ultimate takoyaki kitchen.

In the original ''[[Weekly Shonen Jump]]'' release, the chapter included a [[Cover_Page#Color_Covers|color cover]] at the beginning in addition to Hatchan's cover story, with a tagline advertising this as a "special double cover". This color cover was not included as part of the chapter in the volume, where it was instead used as the volume illustration—though only the character introduction and table of contents separate it from Chapter 217.

The color cover features [[Nefertari Vivi|Vivi]] in a pirate outfit with [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] and a squirrel behind her.

==Short Summary==
After the [[Straw Hat Pirates]] escape from the [[Marines]], everyone in [[Arabasta Kingdom|Arabasta]] rejoices over the recovered peace. [[Smoker]] and [[Tashigi]] promise to continue chasing after [[Roronoa Zoro|Zoro]] and [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] as they look at the duos' new bounties. Meanwhile, on the [[Going Merry]], everybody is depressed about [[Nefertari Vivi|Vivi]]'s departure. A mysterious figure appears before the crew. To their surprise, [[Nico Robin]], the former partner of Crocodile, reveals that she was on the ship the whole time. She then sits down and asks Luffy if she could join his crew.

==Long Summary==
[[Captain (Marine Rank)|Marine Captain]] [[Hina|"Black Cage" Hina]] is finishing up the last of [[Bentham|Mr. 2]]'s forces while on a communication line with one of her colleagues. She is expressing her frustration at having been fooled into a trap as one of Bon Kurei's men attempts to attack her. She drives her arm directly into the attacker, and as she does, her arm encompasses him in a black iron ring that completely restrains him. [[Fullbody|"Iron Fist" Fullbody]] and [[Jango]] fawned over her display of power, with the former commenting that such is the ability of the [[Ori Ori no Mi]]. Hina reveals that the colleague she is speaking with is [[Smoker]], and that the actual source of her disappointment is him. She is upset with Smoker because he seemed to actually be pretty happy when [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] got away from her.

In [[Arabasta Kingdom|Arabasta]], the citizens are still confused as to who [[Nefertari Vivi|Vivi]] was talking to but are nonetheless happy that their princess is okay. They resolve to once again begin rebuilding the city. The Kung Fu Dugongs and the various wildlife of the country are also overjoyed. In [[Yuba]], the citizens are confused as to why [[Toto]] is laughing so much, and he says that he will not tell any of them, leading [[Koza]] to believe he's gone crazy from the sandstorms. Toto is instead recalling his amusing times with Luffy, and he hopes the pirate will return someday to enjoy some water. The citizens discuss more repair work that needs to be done around the country, including the [[Rain Dinners|casino]].

[[Nefertari Cobra|Cobra]] reflects with [[Igaram]] on how much his Vivi has grown, as various parts of the country are shown to still be rejoicing. [[Chaka]] has come to visit Pell's grave, though he finds it strange that he is unable to shed any tears for his friend. Vivi and [[Karoo]] watch on as the [[Marines]] attempt to chase after the [[Straw Hat Pirates]], finally wiping her tears. In another area of the city, a couple of Royal Palace soldiers are discussing [[Matsuge]] as he sits in front of them. They wonder why the Princess has made him a member of the [[Super Spot-Billed Duck Troops]], even though he's a camel. At a doctor's office out in the desert, a [[Pell|man]] is leaving and thanking the doctor for his treatment. The doctor tells him to make sure he gets some more rest, and he wonders why he's in such a hurry. At the last second, the doctor yells at him that he forgot something, and he holds up a white hood adorned with stars. Vivi and Karoo decide to make their way back to [[Alubarna]], as the narrator goes on to describe the amazing rate at which the country rebuilt itself.

Out at sea on Smoker's ship, [[Tashigi]] has finally awoken and comes to the deck. [[Smoker]] pours her some coffee as he is looking at Luffy and [[Roronoa Zoro|Zoro]]'s bounty posters. Smoker recaps Zoro's exploits from [[Whisky Peak]] through Mr. 1's defeat, revealing that he was actually an assassin from the [[West Blue]] known as [[Daz Bonez]]. He comments on how all the powerful people that [[Crocodile]] recruited have been taken down and that they will now once again pursue the Straw Hats, to which Tashigi firmly agrees.

Aboard the [[Going Merry]], Zoro explains that the Marines are no longer pursuing them. However, as he speaks, the other straw hats become increasingly depressed, prompting him to inquire as to what their problem is. [[Tony Tony Chopper|Chopper]], [[Nami]], Luffy, [[Sanji]], and [[Usopp]] are all extremely sad that Vivi is no longer with them, annoying Zoro and causing him to suggest that if they really felt that way, they should have kidnapped her. They each subsequently insult Zoro for suggesting this, but Usopp points out that Luffy's insult makes no sense, only annoying Zoro further. The antics are interrupted, however, by a female stowaway, who comments that they've finally made it out to sea. Zoro braces for combat, Nami is distraught, Sanji fawns over her beauty, Usopp freaks out that an enemy is aboard, Chopper has no idea who she is, and Luffy is somewhat surprised that she is alive. The stowaway is revealed to be [[Nico Robin]] (who they still recognize as "Miss All Sunday"), and she once again uses her [[Hana Hana no Mi|abilities]] to disarm them. Nami asks when she got there, and Robin reveals that she's been there the whole time, taking a bath and reading a book. She has borrowed some of Nami's clothes, angering her further.

Robin asks Luffy if he remembers what he said to her, immediately prompting Sanji to get aggressive with his captain, assuming that he said something reckless to the pretty lady. Luffy grows even more confused, to which Robin implores him to take responsibility. Luffy finally asks her what she wants, and Robin asks Luffy to let her join the crew.

==Quick Reference==
===Chapter Notes===
*The people of the [[Arabasta Kingdom]] resume rebuilding at an accelerated rate, thanks to the inspiration they receive from the [[Nefertari Vivi|princess]].
*[[Daz Bonez|Mr. 1]]'s real name is stated to be "Daz Bonez."
*[[Pell]] is alive.
**He receives medical care from a doctor out in the desert, but accidentally leaves his hood.
*[[Hina]] is revealed to have eaten the [[Ori Ori no Mi]].
*Because of [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]]'s higher bounty and [[Roronoa Zoro|Zoro]]'s new bounty, [[Smoker]] and [[Tashigi]] decide to once again pursue the [[Straw Hat Pirates]].
**Although they decide this now, they are not seen pursuing this agenda again until after the timeskip, during the events of the [[Punk Hazard Arc]].
*[[Nico Robin]] reveals that she stowed away on the [[Going Merry]] to escape the Marines and asks [[Monkey D. Luffy|Luffy]] to accept her into the Straw Hat Pirates, stating Luffy committed a crime in the process.
*This is the last chapter of the [[Arabasta Arc]] as well as the [[Arabasta Saga]].
